lines.en: label tsuneyodorm15:
: Eep!
Did my knocking scare Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: 我的敲门声吓到 Tsuneyo 了？

lines.en: : Stop!
lines.zh: : 别动！

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, it’s just-
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，我只是——

lines.en: : Hold still, gosh darn it! It’s not even that tight!
lines.zh: : 站着别动，真是的！又没那么紧！

lines.en: : And Sir, since I know you’re out there, don’t be getting the wrong idea!
lines.zh: : 还有老师，既然我知道你在外面，就别想歪了！

lines.en: : I’m just helping Tsuneyo into a costume I made for her.
lines.zh: : 我只是在帮 Tsuneyo 穿我给她做的 cos 服。

lines.en: : The door is open. Come tell us how it looks.
lines.zh: : 门开着。进来看看效果怎么样。

lines.en: Ahh, the perks of showing up at exactly the right moment.
lines.zh: 啊，来得早不如来得巧。

lines.en: I sigh to myself and hope that whatever costume Molly made for Tsuneyo this time is a bit more...revealing than the suit of samurai armor she wore to the Halloween party.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，心里盼着 Molly 这次给 Tsuneyo 做的衣服，能比她万圣节派对上穿的那身武士盔甲更……暴露一点。

lines.en: Don’t get me wrong, Tsuneyo was probably the cutest samurai I’ve laid my eyes on, but I’m pretty sure she’d also make a cute-
lines.zh: 别误会，Tsuneyo 大概是我见过最可爱的武士了，但我很确定她扮别的也会很可爱——

lines.en: Uhh, anything with less clothing than a samurai.
lines.zh: 嗯，任何比武士穿得少的东西。

lines.en: So most things.
lines.zh: 也就是绝大多数东西。

lines.en: scene black
I turn the handle to be greeted by some anime theme I’m sure I’ve heard Ami playing around the house once or twice before.
lines.zh: 我转动门把手，迎面而来的是一段动画主题曲，我敢肯定以前在家里听 Ami 放过一两次。

lines.en: I’m certain of this because I immediately feel upset with myself for singing along inside of my head.
lines.zh: 我之所以敢肯定，是因为我立刻为自己跟着在脑子里哼了起来而感到不爽。

lines.en: I am supposed to be devoid of joy. I shall not be swayed by a cute pop song or-
lines.zh: 我本该是毫无喜悦的。我不该被一首可爱的流行歌动摇，或者——

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos1
: Help.
lines.zh: : 救命。

lines.en: Okay, maybe I’ll allow myself to be a little swayed by Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: 好吧，也许我允许自己被 Tsuneyo 稍微动摇一下。

lines.en: : The Emerald Guardian is trying to take me to Virginia.
lines.zh: : 翡翠守护者想带我去弗吉尼亚。

lines.en: : So, honest thoughts, Sir?
lines.zh: : 那么，老师的真实想法呢？

lines.en: : I’m thinking I should have used slightly darker fabric since this seems a little close to her skin tone, but it’s my first time making a costume from scratch for a girl of her color.
lines.zh: : 我在想，我该用再深一点的布料，因为这件看起来跟她的肤色太接近了，不过这是我第一次为她这种肤色的女孩从零开始做衣服。

lines.en: : Also, I didn’t want to deviate too far from the character’s original costume, soooo...what do you think?
lines.zh: : 另外，我不想跟角色原本的服装差太远，所、以……你觉得怎么样？

lines.en: : Do not answer the Guardian’s questions. I do not need to hear your thoughts.
lines.zh: : 别回答守护者的问题。我不需要听你的想法。

lines.en: : Why are you so afraid of hearing what I think? You look great.
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么怕听我的想法？你看起来很棒啊。

lines.en: : Is that how you actually feel or are you just being nice? I kind of need to know if I have to change anything.
lines.zh: : 这是你的真心话，还是你只是在客气？我得知道我还要不要改什么。

lines.en: : He is clearly just being nice. My arms are too muscular and my chest too large to recreate this small magical girl.
lines.zh: : 他显然只是在客气。我的手臂太壮、胸部太大，还原不了这个小小的魔法少女。

lines.en: : Is that really a problem?
lines.zh: : 这真的是问题吗？

lines.en: : I thought the whole thing with cosplay is that you want to put your own spin on characters.
lines.zh: : 我还以为 cosplay 的精髓就是想给角色加上自己的诠释。

lines.en: : I have to spin now?
lines.zh: : 我现在还得转圈了？

lines.en: : Why is this process so complicated?
lines.zh: : 为什么这套流程这么复杂？

lines.en: : Not exactly, Sir. Most cosplayers try to get as close to the original characters as possible.
lines.zh: : 也不完全是，老师。大多数 coser 都会尽量贴近原角色。

lines.en: : Sure, there are some who like putting their own spin on things, but this is not the case for Tsuneyo and me.
lines.zh: : 当然，也有一些人喜欢加入自己的诠释，但我和 Tsuneyo 不属于这种。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos2
: Fine! Spin me!
lines.zh: : 好！那转我吧！

lines.en: : I am prepared!
lines.zh: : 我准备好了！

lines.en: : Not that kind of spinning, Kendo Princess.
lines.zh: : 不是那种转，剑道公主。

lines.en: : What Sir is trying to say is that he thought you were making your own version of the character.
lines.zh: : 老师的意思是，他以为你在做属于你自己的角色版本。

lines.en: : But that’s not-
lines.zh: : 但那不是——

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos3
: That sounds more fun than dressing as a character I don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 那听起来比扮一个我都看不懂的角色有意思多了。

lines.en: : Doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: : How would a normal [teenage]girl have fun in my shoes?
lines.zh: : 一个普通的[teenage]女孩处在我的位置会怎么找乐子？

lines.en: : The only normal [teenage]girl I know would probably call this stupid and storm out to go eat ten pounds of takoyaki.
lines.zh: : 我认识的唯一一个普通[teenage]女孩，大概会骂这玩意儿很蠢，然后冲出去吃上十磅章鱼烧。

lines.en: : Emerald Guardian, unhand me so I can go consume octopus balls like normal girls do.
lines.zh: : 翡翠守护者，放开我，我要去像普通女孩一样吞章鱼丸子了。

lines.en: : But...my costume kind of hinges on the success of yours. We were going as a duo, remember?
lines.zh: : 可是……我的衣服能不能成，可全看你的成不成。我们说好要出双人的，记得吗？

lines.en: : And...I worked really hard on this.
lines.zh: : 而且……我这件做得真的很辛苦。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos4
: What would a normal girl say now, Sir?
lines.zh: : 普通女孩现在会说什么，老师？

lines.en: : Should I fuck her?
lines.zh: : 我该操她吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos5
: ...What?
: Don’t worry, Molly. She doesn’t mean-
lines.zh: : 别担心，Molly。她不是那个意——

lines.en: : Obviously it’s a reference to “fuck you,” Sir. I’m not an imbecile.
lines.zh: : 显然是引用了“操你”那句话，老师。我不是白痴。

lines.en: It's impressive how easily she understood that.
lines.zh: 她竟然这么快就理解了，真是了不起。

lines.en: : But why would Tsuneyo suddenly become so hostile?
lines.zh: : 可 Tsuneyo 为什么突然变得这么有攻击性？

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos6
: Perhaps it is what they call puberty?
lines.zh: : 也许这就是所谓的青春期？

lines.en: : I am becoming a woman and filled with so many hormones that I can’t help but fuck everyone and everything.
lines.zh: : 我正在变成女人，荷尔蒙多得让我忍不住想操所有人和所有东西。

lines.en: : You know...maybe it’s time we-
lines.zh: : 那个……也许我们是时候——

lines.en: : Don’t even bother, Sir. It’s not worth it.
lines.zh: : 别白费劲了，老师。不值得。

lines.en: : Let her find out from one of the other girls. This is out of our hands.
lines.zh: : 让她从别的女孩那儿知道吧。这已经超出我们能管的范围了。

lines.en: : Besides, I kind of need to put the finishing touches on our costumes.
lines.zh: : 而且我还得给咱们的衣服做最后的收尾。

lines.en: : What’s even the reason for this? Halloween just passed a few months ago.
lines.zh: : 说起来这到底是为了什么？万圣节才过去几个月。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos7
: Allow me to explain.
lines.zh: : 请允许我说明一下。

lines.en: : The Emerald Guardian and I are lovers.
lines.zh: : 翡翠守护者和我是恋人。

lines.en: : A less than exceptional start to your explanation, but I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t interested in hearing how the rest plays out.
lines.zh: : 你这个开场不太妙，但如果我说自己不想听后面怎么发展，那就是在撒谎了。

lines.en: : If you’re lovers, why won’t you let her take you to Virginia?
lines.zh: : 既然是恋人，你为什么不肯让她带你去弗吉尼亚？

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos8
: Because I am not Tsuneyo....
lines.zh: : 因为我不是 Tsuneyo……

lines.en: : I am Kyoko Sakura, a magical girl who is going to go on a boat ride with the Emerald Guardian’s character- a girl who I do not remember the name of.
lines.zh: : 我是 Kyoko Sakura，一个要和翡翠守护者扮演的角色一起乘船出游的魔法少女——那个女孩的名字我不记得了。

lines.en: : Sayaka Miki. But, Kendo Princess, it’s important to note that when I reference “shipping” two characters I do not mean putting them on an actual ship.
lines.zh: : Sayaka Miki。不过，剑道公主，有一点很重要：我说“ship”这两个角色的时候，并不是要把她们真的放到船上去。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos9
: Ah, so you intend to pack the characters. I forgot that the word “ship” could also be used that way.
lines.zh: : 啊，所以你打算把这些角色打包。我忘了“ship”这个词还能这么用。

lines.en: : Closer, I suppose, but still not quite.
lines.zh: : 大概算是更接近了，但还是不太对。

lines.en: : What does any of that have to do with being in love?
lines.zh: : 这些跟谈恋爱有什么关系？

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos10
: Your guess is as good as mine. I personally don’t feel like I’m ready for a relationship yet.
lines.zh: : 你问我，我问谁。我个人觉得自己还没准备好谈恋爱。

lines.en: : We’re doing a duo-cosplay and the characters we’re dressing as were {i}definitely{/i} in love but like, not canonically.
lines.zh: : 我们在出双人 cos，我们扮的这两个角色{i}确实{/i}相爱，但……不是官方设定。

lines.en: : What I’m saying is they should have been.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，她们本该是在一起的。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. So you don’t actually love Tsuneyo-
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。所以你其实并不爱 Tsuneyo——

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos11
: You don’t?!
lines.zh: : 你不爱？！

lines.en: : You’re just dressing her up as a girl who you believe is in love with the character that you’re dressing up as.
lines.zh: : 你只是把她打扮成一个你认为爱着你扮的那个角色的女孩。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos12
: Basically, yes.
lines.zh: : 基本上，没错。

lines.en: : My heart is snapping like the neck of a chicken in the hands of my father.
lines.zh: : 我的心正在像落在我父亲手里的鸡脖子一样被拧断。

lines.en: : You’ll live, Tsuneyo. Everyone has their heart broken at least once.
lines.zh: : 你会活下来的，Tsuneyo。每个人至少都会心碎一次。

lines.en: : You are right. I am a strong woman who can sail on a boat with whoever she likes.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我是个坚强的女人，想跟谁上船就上船。

lines.en: : The only love I need is my love for-
lines.zh: : 我唯一需要的爱，是我对面——

lines.en: : Noodles, we know.
lines.zh: : 面条，我们知道。

lines.en: : Why have you not rescued me from the clutches of the Emerald Guardian yet?
lines.zh: : 你为什么还不把我从翡翠守护者的魔爪里救出去？

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos13
: Okay, I’ll be hitting the enrage timer any second if you don’t actually start helping me out, Kendo Princess.
lines.zh: : 好了，你要是再不真的帮我，我马上就要进入狂暴计时了，剑道公主。

lines.en: : How does everything feel? Itchy? Loose? Is it tight anywhere?
lines.zh: : 整体感觉怎么样？痒吗？松吗？有哪里紧吗？

lines.en: : It’s tight everywhere.
lines.zh: : 哪儿都紧。

lines.en: : Is it possible that you maybe have confused our chest-
lines.zh: : 有没有可能你其实把我们的胸——

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos14
: Sizes?!
lines.zh: : 尺寸搞混了？！

lines.en: : I didn’t confuse anything.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没搞混。

lines.en: : I can obviously tell that you were fortunate enough to be born with additional stat points in the breast area, I just didn’t realize {i}how many{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我当然看得出来你天生幸运，在胸部这块多分配了几点属性，我只是没料到多了{i}这么多{/i}。

lines.en: : Sir, you’re well versed in the breasts of [teenage]girls-
lines.zh: : 老师，你对[teenage]女孩的胸部很有研究——

lines.en: : Why, yes I am. Thank you for noticing.
lines.zh: : 哦，是的，我有。谢谢你的关注。

lines.en: : Go ahead and grab Tsuneyo’s other one.
lines.zh: : 去把 Tsuneyo 的另一边也抓一下。

lines.en: : Let me know if you think it’s actually too tight or if she should just suck it up and go as-is.
lines.zh: : 告诉我你是真觉得太紧了，还是她就该忍忍、就这样出片。

lines.en: : Molly, remind me to thank you for this one day.
lines.zh: : Molly，提醒我哪天一定要好好谢你。

lines.en: : Just do it quickly, before she notices.
lines.zh: : 趁她还没反应过来，动作快点。

lines.en: I take a step toward Tsuneyo and-
lines.zh: 我朝 Tsuneyo 迈出一步，然后——

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos15
: Mmm!
I take a step away from Tsuneyo and decide to not sexually assault her today.
lines.zh: 我从 Tsuneyo 身边退开一步，决定今天不性骚扰她。

lines.en: Sorry, Molly.
lines.zh: 抱歉啊，Molly。

lines.en: And sorry, penis. I know you were looking forward to this more than anyone.
lines.zh: 也抱歉啊，老二。我知道你比谁都期待这一刻。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos16
: I think that I am supposed to be mad at you, but this does not feel nearly as bad as I expected it to.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我本该生你的气，但这感觉远没有我预想的那么糟。

lines.en: : Hmm...I guess I can see how this might be a little constraining for someone with your natural stat advantage.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我能理解，对你这种天生属性就占优的人来说，这确实有点束缚。

lines.en: : I’ll make some adjustments so it will be more comfortable for you during the photoshoot.
lines.zh: : 我会改一改，这样拍摄的时候你会舒服些。

lines.en: : Photoshoot?
lines.zh: : 拍摄？

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos17
: Oh, right. Tsuneyo never finished her explanation.
lines.zh: : 哦，对了。Tsuneyo 的解释还没说完。

lines.en: : One of our latest projects in the manga club is doing a group cosplay shoot, and Tsuneyo is filling in for Rin as Kyoko.
lines.zh: : 我们漫画社最近的一个项目是拍一组 cosplay 合照，Tsuneyo 顶替 Rin 来扮 Kyoko。

lines.en: : Why doesn’t Rin just do it?
lines.zh: : 那 Rin 为什么不自己来？

lines.en: : I’m not sure. But I don’t really have time to think about it since I still need to make the final adjustments for my costume as well.
lines.zh: : 我不清楚。不过我也真没时间去想这个，我自己那套衣服的最后调整还没做完。

lines.en: : Poor Futaba’s been waiting on the rest of us to finish since Halloween.
lines.zh: : 可怜的 Futaba 从万圣节就开始等我们其他人弄完了。

lines.en: : Does this mean you’re joining the manga club, Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : 那这么说你是加入漫画社了，Tsuneyo？

lines.en: : Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo？

lines.en: : I am on strike from speaking until I receive my body back.
lines.zh: : 在我拿回自己的身体之前，我罢说。

lines.en: : It was only enjoyable for several seconds.
lines.zh: : 只有那么几秒钟还算享受。

lines.en: : Now I’m just angry and embarrassed.
lines.zh: : 现在我只剩下愤怒和羞耻。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos18
: Go ndéana an diabhal dréimire de cnámh do dhroma ag piocadh úll i ngairdín Ifrinn!
lines.zh: : 愿魔鬼用你的脊骨做成梯子，去地狱的果园里摘苹果！

lines.en: : What the fuck was that?
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么鬼？

lines.en: : Go stand in the corner, Kendo Princess.
lines.zh: : 去墙角站着，剑道公主。

lines.en: : I’ll just take some pictures and let you go back to dressing like a hooligan.
lines.zh: : 我拍几张照就让你回去穿回你那身流氓打扮。

lines.en: : And {i}you{/i} can go back to being pretty like the...pretty girl you are.
lines.zh: : 然后{i}你{/i}就可以继续当你那个……漂亮的漂亮女孩。

lines.en: : Your insults could use a little work, Tsuneyo. But I applaud your effort.
lines.zh: : 你的骂人功夫还有待提高，Tsuneyo。但我欣赏你的努力。

lines.en: scene black
scene tsuneyocos19
: Last chance for any feedback, Sir.
lines.zh: : 老师，最后一次机会给点反馈。

lines.en: : I hate to admit it, but you’ve been entirely unhelpful tonight.
lines.zh: : 我虽然不愿意承认，但你今晚一点忙都没帮上。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I feel kind of bad.
lines.zh: : 不好说。我有点过意不去。

lines.en: : It seems like Tsuneyo isn’t having a very good time.
lines.zh: : 看起来 Tsuneyo 玩得不是很开心。

lines.en: : Nonsense. She’s having the time of her life.
lines.zh: : 胡说。她正乐在其中呢。

lines.en: : It’s true. I’m finally experiencing what it means to be young.
lines.zh: : 没错。我终于体会到年轻是什么感觉了。

lines.en: : Then why do you look so mad?
lines.zh: : 那你怎么看起来这么生气？

lines.en: : Because the Emerald Guardian was extremely attractive in her costume and I look stupid.
lines.zh: : 因为翡翠守护者穿上那身衣服美极了，而我看起来很蠢。

lines.en: : The manga club will never deem this a suitable cosplay if I don’t resemble Kyoko Sakura, professional sailor.
lines.zh: : 如果我不像 Kyoko Sakura——职业船员，漫画社绝不会认可这套 cos。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos20
: Magical girl. Not a sailor, Kendo Princess. It’s not that kind of ship.
lines.zh: : 是魔法少女，不是船员，剑道公主。不是那种船。

lines.en: : Also, the girls would never hold something like that against you.
lines.zh: : 而且那些女孩绝不会因为这种事为难你。

lines.en: : Also I was groped. I think I am supposed to be mad about that.
lines.zh: : 而且我还被摸了。我觉得我应该为此生气。

lines.en: : That’s just a thing that’s going to happen if you’re going to dress up. I’m not fully accustomed to your...assets yet.
lines.zh: : 你要是玩 cos，这种事迟早会碰上。我还没完全习惯你的……本钱。

lines.en: : Have you even seen yourself in the costume yet, Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，你还没看过自己穿这套衣服的样子吧？

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos21
: Impossible. All I can see are my limbs.
lines.zh: : 不可能。我只看得见自己的四肢。

lines.en: : And they are large and unlike that of the Emerald Guardian, who has small, dainty, weak limbs.
lines.zh: : 而且它们又粗又大，一点也不像翡翠守护者那种纤细、娇小、无力的四肢。

lines.en: : Wow. Okay.
lines.zh: : 哇。好吧。

lines.en: : Molly, just take a picture of Tsuneyo and show it to her.
lines.zh: : Molly，给 Tsuneyo 拍张照，拿给她看。

lines.en: : An excellent decision, Sir! We’ll show the Kendo Princess how cute she is and it will immediately dispel any worries she has!
lines.zh: : 英明的决定，老师！我们要让剑道公主看看自己有多可爱，这样她所有的顾虑都会一扫而空！

lines.en: : An excellent plan. You truly are the Herald of the Adolescents.
lines.zh: : 计划绝佳。你果真是青春期的先驱。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, pose!
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，摆姿势！

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos22
: P-Pose how?
lines.zh: : 摆、摆什么姿势？

lines.en: : I don’t know any poses!
lines.zh: : 我什么姿势都不会！

lines.en: : Any pose! Make yourself look cool!
lines.zh: : 什么姿势都行！把自己摆得酷一点！

lines.en: : Uhh...uhhh!
lines.zh: : 呃……呃呃呃！

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos23
: Pose!
lines.zh: : 摆姿势！

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos23
: Welp, better than nothing.
lines.zh: : 唉，总比什么都没有强。

lines.en: : Come see how you look.
lines.zh: : 过来看看你什么样。

lines.en: scene black
scene tsuneyocos24
: See? You don’t look stupid at all.
lines.zh: : 看吧？你一点也不蠢。

lines.en: : You...made me look cute.
lines.zh: : 你……把我拍得好可爱。

lines.en: : Your powers truly {i}are{/i} real.
lines.zh: : 你的能力果然{i}是{/i}真的。

lines.en: : I’m offended that you ever doubted them.
lines.zh: : 你居然怀疑过，我很受伤。

lines.en: : And that pose is so...brave.
lines.zh: : 还有那个姿势真是……勇敢。

lines.en: : Sure, yes. Very brave.
lines.zh: : 对，没错。非常勇敢。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos25
: How did you know that this would work?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道这样能行？

lines.en: : Can you predict the future?
lines.zh: : 你能预知未来？

lines.en: : No. I don’t have the same sort of...powers as Molly.
lines.zh: : 不能。我没有 Molly 那种……能力。

lines.en: : I just figured that there was no way you’d still feel weird about yourself after seeing what you actually looked like.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，看到自己真正的样子之后，你不可能还会对自己感觉奇怪。

lines.en: : You believed in me?
lines.zh: : 你相信我？

lines.en: : Ehh, I wouldn’t say I {i}believed{/i} in you.
lines.zh: : 呃，我可不会说我{i}信{/i}你。

lines.en: : I just spend pretty much every waking moment looking at [teenage]girls, so I like to think of myself as a good judge of them.
lines.zh: : 我只是几乎每个醒着的时刻都在看[teenage]女孩，所以我自认为对她们的鉴赏力还不错。

lines.en: I mean, I’m also lucky enough that literally everyone in my class is attractive, so that definitely helps with the, uhh...judgement.
lines.zh: 我是说，我也很幸运，班上的每一个人都很好看，这对我的……呃……鉴赏肯定大有帮助。

lines.en: : And as someone who has spent just as long, if not longer, peering into the depths of her computer screen in search of the perfect waifu-
lines.zh: : 而作为一个同样没日没夜、甚至更久地盯着电脑屏幕深处、寻找完美 waifu 的人——

lines.en: : I, too, know {i}moe{/i} when I see it, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 我也一样，一眼就能认出{i}萌{/i}来，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos26
: Uh-oh! Time for another weebnote!
lines.zh: : 啊哦！又要来一段宅知识小课堂了！

lines.en: : Moe’s a certain type of cuteness that transcends rational grading scales-
lines.zh: : 萌是一种超越理性评判标准的、特定类型的可爱——

lines.en: : A type of cuteness you can feel inside of your {i}bones{/i}.
lines.zh: : 一种你能在{i}骨子里{/i}感受到的可爱。

lines.en: : Like when a girl in an anime gets really nervous on the first day of[school] and forgets how to write her name during her introduction...
lines.zh: : 就像动画里的女孩在[school]第一天紧张得在自我介绍时忘了怎么写自己的名字……

lines.en: : Or when a tsundere character finally cracks and says something nice to the protagonist.
lines.zh: : 或者一个傲娇角色终于破防，对主角说了句好话。

lines.en: : It’s a certain type of cute that real humans could never hope to replicate. One that tells you anything and everything about a character from a single action.
lines.zh: : 那是一种真实的人类永远无法复制的可爱。一种只凭一个动作就能告诉你关于一个角色一切的可爱。

lines.en: : And you, Kendo Princess-
lines.zh: : 而你，剑道公主——

lines.en: : You embody moe.
lines.zh: : 你就是萌的化身。

lines.en: : ...Sometimes.
lines.zh: : ……有时候是。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocos27
: I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : It appears that I prematurely judged myself without factoring in your abilities and knowledge.
lines.zh: : 看来我没有把你的能力和知识算进去，就过早地给自己下了判断。

lines.en: : I apologize for getting angry when you groped me.
lines.zh: : 你摸我的时候我对你发火，我道歉。

lines.en: : I understand now that it needed to be done.
lines.zh: : 我现在明白了，那是必要的。

lines.en: : I mean, I probably could have figured it out without doing that, but...
lines.zh: : 我是说，也许不那样也能弄明白，不过……

lines.en: : Fan service. You know?
lines.zh: : 福利画面嘛。你懂的？

lines.en: : I do not. Please bestow unto me more of your wisdom, Emerald Guardian.
lines.zh: : 我不懂。请把更多智慧赐予我吧，翡翠守护者。

lines.en: : Well, Tsuneyo. Fan service is when-
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，Tsuneyo。福利画面就是——

lines.en: scene black
I decide to head out while the two of them still have their eyes closed.
lines.zh: 我趁她们俩还闭着眼睛，决定先撤。

lines.en: I’m not really in the mood to listen to more weebnotes and I’ve already gotten to see Tsuneyo in costume so...
lines.zh: 我实在没心情再听一段宅知识科普，而且我已经看到 Tsuneyo 穿 cos 服的样子了，所以……

lines.en: I guess I’ve accomplished pretty much everything I came in here to accomplish.
lines.zh: 我想，我来这儿想看的基本都看完了。

lines.en: I’m a little surprised to hear Tsuneyo talk about being embarrassed or...whatever it was she felt, though.
lines.zh: 不过听到 Tsuneyo 说自己害羞，或者……不管她当时是什么感受，我倒是有些意外。

lines.en: It’s not often she lets her actual feelings slip out.
lines.zh: 她不常把真实的情绪流露出来。

lines.en: But I guess that all of us uncage our true selves from time to time.
lines.zh: 但我想，我们所有人偶尔都会把真正的自己放出来。

lines.en: And, a lot of the time, that kills us.
lines.zh: 而大多数时候，那会要了我们的命。

lines.en: Or, in less drastic circumstances, makes us feel like shit.
lines.zh: 或者，在不那么极端的情况下，让我们觉得自己很垃圾。

lines.en: But sometimes, like tonight in particular, it has the opposite effect.
lines.zh: 但有时候，比如今晚，效果恰恰相反。

lines.en: And even though I didn’t stick around for the discussion of fan service, I feel like Tsuneyo gained a few points in...confidence or something.
lines.zh: 而尽管我没留下来听关于福利画面的讨论，我觉得 Tsuneyo 在……自信之类的属性上涨了几分。

lines.en: Is confidence a stat in RPGs?
lines.zh: 自信是 RPG 里的一个属性吗？

lines.en: Who even knows?
lines.zh: 谁知道呢。

lines.en: I’m just going to go home and ask Molly to send me that picture of Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: 我就这么回家，让 Molly 把那张 Tsuneyo 的照片发给我。

lines.en: I'm sure her weird pose won't get in the way of my...research.
lines.zh: 我确信她那个奇怪的姿势不会妨碍我的……研究。

{i}Tsuneyo’s affection has increased to [tsuneyo_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Tsuneyo 的好感度提升到了 [tsuneyo_love]!{/i}
